text: At the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre’s Annual Meeting held on June 20, 2019, the membership of the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre nominated the five individuals above for appointment by Toronto and East York Community Council to the Board of Management of the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre. Appointments to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board of Management is a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the Public Appointments Policy.The nominees are qualified to serve on the Board of Management, pursuant to the terms established by the Relationship Framework for Board-Run Community Centres and the City of Toronto’s Public Appointments Policy. By this letter, the Board of Management requests that all individuals named be…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at pleasure of Council, the following nominees to the Board of Management for a two-year term of office ending on June 30, 2020, and until successors are appointed: Ademi De Castro Jennifer King David Sobel Razia Dawood Winston Yu
